## Join the group

We are always happy to hear from motivated students interested in spatial ecology, animal movement or quantitative methods.

- **TFM (MSc thesis)**: we offer projects every year within the UCM Master's programmes in Conservation Biology and Zoology, usually linked to our active projects. Write to us in spring for the following academic year.
- **PhD**: we support applications to competitive fellowships (FPU, FPI, Comunidad de Madrid, Marie Skłodowska-Curie). Get in touch early with a short description of your interests and a CV.
- **Postdocs and visitors**: we host visiting researchers and support fellowship applications (Juan de la Cierva, Ramón y Cajal, MSCA). If our research aligns with yours, let's talk.

Contact: [gfandos@ucm.es](mailto:gfandos@ucm.es)
